g.text: One matrix makes a query, key and value for every token. RoPE rotates queries and keys
by position. scaled_dot_product_attention computes softmax(q·k / √64) · v, with a
causal mask so no token can see the future.
# causal mask only needed when the queries cover the same span as the key
